## 2900 - 2905

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02900">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2900 FPC - Static pressure falls below low calibration limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02900">

Exception 2900 is an exception that defaults with a severity of 0. A user will need to go the Exception Description editor and set the severity to a value between 1 and 5 for this exception to be generated. This exception is also unique in that it can be enabled on a per meter basis in the Meter Editor, Exceptions tab. Once a severity is set, a user will need to set a Static Pressure Low Calibration limit in the Volume Editor. A user will need to navigate to the Characteristics, and double click the desired record. Then they will need to navigate to the Ranges tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 629;height: 275;" />

When the Static pressure goes below the low limit (in this case 0), then the exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02901">

A user will need to go the Exception Description editor and set the severity to a value between 1-5 for this exception to be generated. This exception is also unique in that it can be enabled on a per meter basis in the Meter Editor, Exceptions tab. This exception is only for meter types that have a Differential Pressure flowing parameter. Once a severity is set, a user will need to set a Differential Pressure Low Calibration limit in the Volume Editor. A user will need to navigate to the Characteristics, and double click the desired record. Then they will need to navigate to the Ranges tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 624;height: 270;" />

When the Differential pressure falls below the low limit (in this case 0), then the exception will be generated.

</div>
